description_en: In the area of ​​Kinostudios, we offer an apartment for sale of the typology 1+1. The apartment has an area of ​​74m2 gross and 67m2 net. It is organized in a distribution corridor. Has regular mortgage documentation. For more details or a visit to the property, contact me.
